title: 1，天崩开局啊！
slug: 人在俄乌当佣兵杀敌就能爆属性
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“你们这些杀人犯，强奸犯，纵火犯....低头，看看你们这副样子。”

“肮脏的像下水道里爬出来的老鼠。”

毛熊，某座戒备森严的监狱。

一个穿着深色外套，脚下踩着厚重军靴的光头壮汉，面无表情的骂着操场中央站着上百名囚犯。

这些都是重刑犯，普通杀人犯在他们中间，都能算得上好人！

可是面对眼前光头男人的辱骂，他们安静得像一群被掐住脖子的狗。

没有人敢骂回去，

甚至没有人敢露出愤怒的表情。

因为他们很清楚，

这个光头壮汉不是监狱长，而是普利维奇。

比起这个名字，

他还有几个更加渗人的身份。

瓦格纳雇佣兵老板，统帅在圣彼得堡时期的好朋友，以及御用厨子。

没有人知道，这位平日里只能在新闻里见到的顶天大人物，今天为什么会有空站在这里，专门骂他们这群烂在监狱里的重刑犯。

也没有人敢问，只能老老实实听着。

“毛熊的母亲会唾弃你们，法官厌恶你们...民众希望你们永远被关在这里，直到死亡！！！”

普利维奇的目光从众人脸上一一扫过，停顿了几秒再次开口道，“不过。”

“现在有一个能活下去的机会，就摆在你们的面前！”

重刑犯还能有什么机会？

他们这些人，从被押进这座监狱的那一天起，未来就已经被写死了。

不是烂在牢房里，就是被带去某个冰冷的地方执行判决。

因为说这话的是普利维奇，一个真的能决定他们生死的男人，所以不少重刑犯都猛地抬起了头。

被这么多重刑犯盯着，其实是一件压力很大的事情，普通人甚至会被吓得落荒而逃。

对于普利维奇来说，这几十双凶神恶煞的眼神，就像是圣彼得堡深夜小巷里，那些站在霓虹灯下等客的妓女一样人畜无害。

甚至还不如她们有威胁。

至少那些姑娘们懂得察言观色，知道什么时候该笑，什么时候该闭嘴，什么时候该把手伸进客人的口袋。

而眼前这些重刑犯？

他们只会用最原始的愤怒和最廉价的凶狠，来掩饰自己毫无城府的内心。

普利维奇嘴角微微扬起，知道铺垫结束了，该进入正题了：“毕竟，你们被关在这里太久了，也许不知道外面发生了什么。”

“二毛想加入北约，北约想把炮口推到我们的家门口。”

“他们给二毛武器，给二毛钱，给二毛承诺。”

“他们说这是自由，这是民主，这是文明世界的选择。”

“狗屁。”

“他们要的不是自由，他们要的是我们低头，我们的土地，我们的资源，我们的尊严，还有我们的未来。”

“他们想让毛熊跪下当狗！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"You murderers, rapists, arsonists... lower your heads and look at what you look like."

"Dirty like rats crawling out of sewers."

Mao Xiong, a high-security prison.

A bald man wearing a dark coat and heavy military boots was expressionlessly cursing hundreds of prisoners standing in the middle of the playground.

These are all serious criminals, and ordinary murderers can be considered good people among them!

But faced with the insults from the bald man in front of them, they were as quiet as a group of dogs being choked.

No one dares to curse back,

No one even dared to show an angry expression.

Because they know very well,

This bald man was not the warden, but Privich.

Compared to this name,

He also has several more pervasive identities.

Wagner's mercenary boss, the commander's good friend during his time in St. Petersburg, and his royal cook.

No one knows why this big shot, who can only be seen in the news on weekdays, has the time to stand here today and scold these serious criminals who are rotting in prison.

No one dared to ask, so they could only listen honestly.

"The mother of the furry bear will spurn you, the judge will hate you... the people hope that you will be locked up here forever until you die!!!"

Privich's eyes swept across everyone's faces one by one, and he paused for a few seconds before speaking again, "But."

"Now there is a chance to survive, right in front of you!"

What chance do felons have?

The future of these people has been written in stone from the day they were taken to this prison.

Either rot in a cell or be taken to some cold place to execute the sentence.

Because the person who said this was Privich, a man who could really decide their life or death, many felons raised their heads suddenly.

Being stared at by so many serious criminals is actually a very stressful thing, and ordinary people may even be scared and run away.

To Privich, these dozens of pairs of menacing eyes were as harmless as those prostitutes standing under neon lights waiting for customers in late-night alleys in St. Petersburg.

Not even as threatening as them.

At least those girls know how to read and know when to laugh, when to shut up, and when to put their hands in the guests' pockets.

And these felons in front of us?

They will only use the most primitive anger and the cheapest ferocity to cover up their heartless heart.

Privich raised the corners of his mouth slightly, knowing that the foreshadowing was over and it was time to get to the point: "After all, you have been locked up here for too long, and you may not know what is happening outside."

"Ermao wants to join NATO, and NATO wants to push its guns to our doorstep."

"They gave them 20 cents of weapons, 20 cents of money, and 20 cents of promises."

"They say this is freedom, this is democracy, this is the choice of the civilized world."

"Shit."

"What they want is not freedom, they want us to bow our heads, our land, our resources, our dignity, and our future."

"They want the furry bear to kneel down and be a dog!"
